dog.description_text:
Kima is a very sweet girl who came to us after losing her home. Despite all the changes in her life, she loves meeting new people and is always happy to make a new friend. Kima is playful, affectionate, and happiest when she’s getting plenty of attention from her favorite people.
Kima likes some dogs more than others, so any potential canine friends should be a good match for her. She would do best in a home with older children or adults only. This sweet girl is ready to put the past behind her and find a loving home of her own.
dog.name: Kima
